sources.citation: Lipembe, Pembe Peter Agustini. 2010. Exploring the micro-social dynamics of intergenerational language transmission: a critical analysis of parents' attitudes and language use patterns among Ndamba speakers in Tanzania. PhD dissertation, University of the Western Cape. 344 pp.
sources.note: Silent. Sociolinguistic study of language shift; full-text search for stress/penult/tone/accent/prosod finds only non-phonological uses; no description of Ndamba phonology and no citation of Novotná or Edelsten & Lijongwa.

sources.citation: Maho, Jouni Filip. 2009. NUGL Online: The online version of the New Updated Guthrie List.

sources.citation: Nurse, Derek. 2008. Tense and Aspect in Bantu. Oxford: OUP. Appendix matrix 'G52 Chi-ndamba' (RMCA online appendices).
sources.note: Silent on Ndamba: the G52 entry is a TA paradigm matrix only. The sister-language G51 Pogolo note (same file, ~line 5190) reads 'Penultimate stress, no tones' and 'G51 and G52 are quite similar' — a statement about Pogolo, not Ndamba.

sources.citation: Nurse, Derek & Gérard Philippson (eds.). 2003. The Bantu Languages. London: Routledge (Part 2).

sources.note: Nothing on stress; segment inventory only (i e a u o; b t̠ʃ d f ɡ ɣ h d̠ʒ k l m n ŋ p s t v w j), no tone rows, no prosodic notes.
